subtitle: On-device meeting notes
promotionalText: Now transcribes Catalan and Spanish on-device, plus a Fast engine for 25 languages and an Automatic mode that picks the right one for you.
description:
Distavo turns your meetings into clean, structured Markdown notes — entirely on your terms.

Record a meeting with one click (or drop any audio or video file into a watched folder) and Distavo takes it from there: it transcribes the conversation with speaker labels, cleans the transcript, and writes a concise summary with decisions and action points as a Markdown note you can file anywhere.

CATALAN AND SPANISH, ON-DEVICE
Two built-in models from the Barcelona Supercomputing Center's Projecte AINA transcribe Catalan, Spanish, Galician and Basque entirely on your Mac: Languages of Spain (all four) and a Catalan-only model trained on 3,370 hours of speech. Both need a Mac with 16 GB memory or more.

FAST, FOR 25 EUROPEAN LANGUAGES
The Fast engine (NVIDIA Parakeet) transcribes English, French, German, Italian, Portuguese and 20 other European languages in a fraction of the time other engines take.

AUTOMATIC MODE
Distavo listens to three short windows spread across the recording, detects the language, and picks the right engine for you: the Catalan/Spanish models for Catalan, Spanish, Galician or Basque, Fast for its 25 languages, and Whisper for everything else. "Download now" in Settings fetches a model ahead of your first meeting; "Remove downloaded models" deletes it again.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Transcription runs on-device on Apple Silicon
• Summaries come from an Ollama server you control — your own Mac or a machine on your network
• No accounts, no cloud, no telemetry: recordings and notes never leave the machines you choose

BUILT-IN MEETING RECORDER
• Captures the meeting audio playing on your Mac (the other participants) plus your microphone (macOS 14.4+)
• Works with any meeting app — nothing to install in your browser or conferencing tool

A TIDY PIPELINE
• Watches a folder: every new recording becomes a note automatically
• Speaker-labelled transcripts, timestamp-free and readable
• Notes are validated before they are written — no half-finished summaries
• Activity log so you can see exactly what happened and when

FLEXIBLE ENGINES
• Built-in on-device transcription — Whisper, Fast, and the Catalan/Spanish models, chosen automatically or by hand
• Or point Distavo at your own WhisperX server
• Summaries via your own Ollama server (local or LAN)

Requires macOS 14 or later. On-device transcription needs Apple Silicon; the Catalan/Spanish models need 16 GB memory or more. The built-in recorder needs macOS 14.4 or later. Summaries require an Ollama server you run yourself.
